overview.tagline: Fuuz WMS Accelerator — warehouse management package
description: A packaged warehouse management application built on the FUUZ platform — receiving, inventory, cycle counting, picking, packing, and shipping in one importable Fuuz package.

A warehouse operation needs to run receiving through shipping against a single, status-driven data model — without stitching together point solutions or writing custom flows for every process. The WMS Accelerator packages the full order-to-cash warehouse cycle: receive inbound goods, manage tracked inventory, pick and pack against configurable methods, and ship with generated carrier documentation.

highlights.title: Receiving to shipping
highlights.body: 52 data models, 43 screens and 49 data flows: receiving, inventory, cycle counting, picking, packing and shipping.

highlights.title: Shipping documents included
highlights.body: Bill of Lading, Box Content Label, Commercial Invoice, Packing List, Pick Sheet and Shipping Label designs.

highlights.title: Statuses ready to use
highlights.body: Seeded inventory, load, pick, order and shipment statuses, handling unit types and carrier codes.

pricing.detail: Fuuz accelerators are no cost; you pay only for the Fuuz runtime.

support.sla: No service level agreement. Supported once implemented by a Fuuz services professional or an approved Fuuz partner.

security.notes: It connects to an external ERP or host only through the Fuuz Integration Orchestrator, if you set that up.

prerequisites: The Cross-Tenant Integration listing (Integration Orchestrator), if you'll connect an external ERP or host system

steps.text: Review the import preview and confirm the import.
Configure your site structure: Area, Zone, Storage Unit.
Set up Business Partners and load your Products.
Set the tenant-wide Move, Pack and Pick behavior in Application Configuration.
